_doc: Render massing for the Onze-Lieve-Vrouwekerk and Gravenkapel, read by pipeline/src/scene.ts. Metres in Lambert 72 around 'anchor' (centre of GRB footprint 1742613), u along 'axis_deg' (west towers -> east choir), v to the north. From DHMV II on that footprint: west towers at u -28..-21, south one to ~36 m and north one to ~30 m; nave ridge ~26 m at v ~9; transept ridge ~24 m at u ~-10 across v -6..24; choir ridge ~24 m; Gravenkapel on the south side (v -13..-5) with its ridge ~20 m; aisles and chapels 10-15 m. Dark grey Tournai stone, softened toward style A; slate roofs; low slate tent roofs on the towers (notes.md, refs/).

parts.id: aisles, chapels and porches (whole GRB footprint)
